find.title: Find Your Team
find.subtitle: Are you starting a new team or joining an existing one?

createCard.title: Create a new Team
createCard.body: Become the team lead and invite teammates.

joinCard.title: Join an existing Team
joinCard.body: Use a code or scan a QR code shared by your team lead.

join.title: Join Your Team
join.body: Scan your team's QR code or enter their code below to join.
join.fallbackHint: If that doesn't work, you can enter the code instead.

errors.not_team_code: That is not a team code. Scan the QR code your team shows, or type the code.
errors.rate_limited: Too many failed attempts. Please wait a minute.
errors.not_started: The rallye hasn't been started yet. Ask your coordinator to start the run, then try again.
errors.paused: The run is paused. Ask your coordinator to resume it, then try again.
errors.ended: This run has already ended, so you can't join a team anymore.
errors.already_in_team: You're already in a team in this run. To switch, please ask the coordination. Don't leave your team yourself: as a guest you can't get back into the run afterwards.
errors.unknown: Could not join this team. Please try again.
errors.cameraDenied: Camera access denied. Please enter the code manually.
errors.cameraUnavailable: The camera cannot be started right now. Please type the code instead.
errors.scanHint: If someone sent you a QR-code link, scanning it will take you straight to the correct rallye.
errors.departed: You left this run or were removed from your team, so you cannot join it again. Please contact the game lead.
errors.org_archived: This run is no longer available because its organization was archived.

pickName.title: Pick a Team name together
pickName.info: You're setting your team name up for your group.
pickName.nameHelper: Your Team Name will be visible to other players.

errors.forbidden: This name can't be used. Try another team name.
errors.taken: This name is already taken in this run.
errors.unknown: Could not save this name. Please try again.

pending.title: Pick a Team name together
pending.info: Only your team member that created this team can enter the name for your group.
pending.discussionPrompt: Talk to your team lead. They pick the name.
pending.connectionLost: Could not refresh the status. Please reload the page.

invite.title: Invite Your Team
invite.qrHelp: Ask your team members to scan this QR code to join you.
invite.codeFallback: If scanning doesn't work, they can enter this code:
invite.footerHint: Once all of your team members have joined, tap Continue.

errors.lookupFailed: We could not check whether you already have a team. Please try again.
errors.not_started: Ask the coordination to start the run.
errors.paused: Ask the coordination to resume the run.
errors.ended: This run has already ended, so you can't join a team anymore.
errors.team_limit: All teams for this run have already been formed. Join an existing team. The game lead will help you.
errors.unknown: Could not create the team. Please try again.
errors.already_in_team: You're already in a team in this run. To switch, please ask the coordination. Don't leave your team yourself: as a guest you can't get back into the run afterwards.
errors.departed: You left this run or were removed from your team, so you cannot join it again. Please contact the game lead.
errors.org_archived: This run is no longer available because its organization was archived.

refusedTitle.not_started: The run has not started yet

invite.waitsForRun: Stay on this page. It moves on by itself as soon as the run is running.

waiting.title: You've joined the team!
waiting.subtitle: Waiting for your teammates to join.

ready.title: Your Team is ready!
ready.body: Your Team is fully set up and ready to start.

noRuns.title: Not in a run yet
noRuns.body: You take part in a run with the join code or link the coordination sends you. Enter your code here to join.
noRuns.removed: You are no longer in a team of your last run. The coordination may have removed you from the team. If this is a mistake, please talk to them.
